decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks remain closely tied to the firm's dental materials, thermoforming expertise, and laboratory channels, so accumulated learning should make continuation more attractive than withdrawal.
The PETG thermoforming blank sits at the core of the firm's established dental materials capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to refine the product and little reason to exit.
Intraoral contrast spray supports digital dental workflows that fit the firm's strategic direction, and the firm has the technical and commercial knowledge to keep improving and selling it.
The custom earmold line builds directly on long-standing hearing-care custom manufacturing know-how, making retention and incremental optimisation the likely choice.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a related extension of the firm's earmold expertise and channels, so they are likely to be kept, though they remain somewhat more peripheral than the core hearing portfolio.
